notablePrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Gerrard, adding one mana of any color.
Gerrard dies, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Gerrard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Gerrard trigger, returning all artifact and creature cards put into your graveyard this turn to the battlefield.
Repeat.
